_readme: SECRET: contains future market events. Never place this file under public/. Prices are in RUPEES here; the seed converts to paise. Impacts are basis points (100 bps = 1%). A company entry in an event REPLACES its industry entry for that event (use it for mitigations). Missing company sizing fields are derived from settings.sizing.

companies.name: Byteswallow Technologies
companies.description: Cloud software giant whose servers famously run on filter coffee. Sells subscriptions to everything, including subscriptions.

companies.name: Quanta Chips Ltd
companies.description: Semiconductor maker dependent on imported rare-earth metals. CEO collects warehouses as a hobby.

companies.name: Memestream Media
companies.description: Short-video and satire network. Revenue rises whenever anyone else has a bad day.

companies.name: Tower of Babble Telecom
companies.description: Mobile network with the most towers and the fewest working calls. Highly sensitive to spectrum regulation.

companies.name: Suryavanshi Solar Power
companies.description: Renewable producer. Panels use rare-earth components; profits follow both sunshine and subsidies.

companies.name: Crude Awakening Petroleum
companies.description: Oil explorer and refiner. Benefits when crude prices rise, suffers when anyone says 'green'.

companies.name: Gridlock Power Utilities
companies.description: Regulated electricity distributor. Boring, steady, occasionally blacked out.

companies.name: DosaDash Foods
companies.description: Food-delivery app that promises a dosa in 9 minutes. Burns cash, gains users.

companies.name: Chaiwala Brands
companies.description: Packaged tea and snacks. Rural demand depends heavily on the monsoon.

companies.name: Kurta Kraft Apparel
companies.description: Textile and apparel maker. Buys most of its cotton from a single region.

companies.name: PillPop Pharma
companies.description: Generic-drug exporter with a large but ageing product portfolio.

companies.name: HealHub Hospitals
companies.description: Hospital chain. Stable cash flows, expanding into tier-2 cities.

companies.name: Genomix Biolabs
companies.description: Biotech start-up with one blockbuster candidate in late-stage trials. Very high risk.

companies.name: Paisa Vasool Bank
companies.description: Mid-sized private bank. Earns more when interest rates rise; large exposure to real-estate loans.

companies.name: Hodl Finserv
companies.description: Fintech lender and digital wallet. Growth story; dislikes regulation and rate hikes.

companies.name: Bima Bharosa Insurance
companies.description: General insurer. Pays out after disasters, invests premiums in bonds.

companies.name: Rail Rocket Infra
companies.description: Builds railway corridors on government contracts. Debt-heavy.

companies.name: Concrete Dreams Cement
companies.description: Cement producer. Demand tracks construction spending; energy-intensive kilns.

companies.name: Jet Lag Airways
companies.description: Low-cost airline. Fuel is its biggest cost; unions are its second biggest.

companies.name: Sagar Shipping & Logistics
companies.description: Container shipping and ports. Gains when trade routes are disrupted elsewhere — sometimes.

rounds.title: The Daily Dalal — Vol. 1: Monsoon Mania

bulletins.title: Met department: monsoon to be 'embarrassingly generous'
bulletins.content: Rural consumption stocks rally; Chaiwala Brands leads.

rounds.title: The Daily Dalal — Vol. 2: Dosa Wars

bulletins.title: DosaDash posts first-ever quarterly profit
bulletins.content: Analysts drop their filter coffee. Food-delivery rival stocks unaffected.

rounds.title: The Daily Dalal — Vol. 3: The Governor Clears His Throat

bulletins.title: Reserved Bank of Fictionia hikes rates by 75 bps
bulletins.content: Banks cheer; borrowers and builders sulk.

rounds.title: The Daily Dalal — Vol. 4: Rare Earth, Rare Temper

bulletins.title: Zanzibaria bans rare-earth exports overnight
bulletins.content: Chip and solar makers scramble. Quanta Chips' stockpile softens the blow.

rounds.title: The Daily Dalal — Vol. 5: Crude Awakening

bulletins.title: Crude spikes 30% after pipeline 'misplaced'
bulletins.content: Oil producers gush; airlines and shippers gasp.

rounds.title: The Daily Dalal — Vol. 6: Miracle Molecule

bulletins.title: Genomix wonder-drug clears final trial
bulletins.content: Genomix soars; PillPop's competing generic loses its shine.

rounds.title: The Daily Dalal — Vol. 7: Can You Hear Me Now?

bulletins.title: Spectrum auction scandal engulfs Tower of Babble
bulletins.content: Licences frozen. Memestream's ratings explode covering it.

rounds.title: The Daily Dalal — Vol. 8: Budget Bonanza

bulletins.title: Finance minister unveils record infrastructure budget
bulletins.content: Rail and cement order books overflow; power distributors get grid upgrades.

bulletins.title: Pink bollworm wipes out cotton belt
bulletins.content: Kurta Kraft's input costs balloon. Separately, the airline pilots' strike ends.

rounds.title: The Daily Dalal — Vol. 10: The Final Audit

bulletins.title: Auditors find Paisa Vasool Bank's real-estate book 'creatively valued'
bulletins.content: Bank stocks slide; Hodl's digital deposits surge as customers flee.

events.name: DosaDash turns profitable
events.notes: R1 interview: CEO says 'next quarter will surprise even my mother'.

events.name: Rate hike
events.notes: R2: governor 'concerned about inflation' in a cricket-commentary column.

events.name: Rare-earth export ban
events.notes: R1: QBIT CEO buying warehouses (mitigation). R3: Zanzibaria border tensions.

events.name: Crude price spike
events.notes: R3/R4: pipeline maintenance gossip on the horoscope page.

events.name: Genomix trial success
events.notes: R2 and R4: lab interns spotted celebrating; R5 sceptic op-ed (misleading).

events.name: Spectrum scandal
events.notes: R5: anonymous letter about auction irregularities.

events.name: Infrastructure budget
events.notes: R6: finance ministry orders 10,000 hard hats.

events.name: Cotton crop failure
events.notes: R6 agriculture brief mentions pests in the single region KURT sources from.

events.name: Airline strike resolved
events.notes: R8: union leader photographed at the CEO's birthday party.

events.name: Bank audit scandal
events.notes: R3 profile: PVSB's large real-estate exposure. R7: resignation of PVSB's auditor.
